INGRED.description: A food or drink used as an ingredient: produce, meat and fish, dairy, grains, spices, oils, condiments and named sauces, including general terms like "meat" or "spices". Include words that say which kind it is, e.g. "ground beef", "yellow onions", "chicken stock".
do_not_mark: dishes and meals, e.g. pizza, soup, lasagna, burger, cake
a bare "sauce" or "dressing" without saying which one
quantities, preparation and cooking words, e.g. "two cups of", "chopped", "fried"

examples.text: Brown the ground beef, then add the yellow onions and a splash of soy sauce.
Our go-to weeknight dinner is homemade pizza with fresh basil.
